item.title: Cisco Expressway vulnerability exploited to breach internal networks (CVE-2026-76466)
item.description: Attackers have been spotted exploiting a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-76466) in Cisco Expressway gateways to breach organizations, Russian security company F6 revealed late last week. The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Friday, along with CVE-2026-123890, a VMware vCenter authentication bypass vulnerability that has been exploited as a zero-day for months by a suspected China-nexus espionage group. item.title: Cleverbridge alerts customers that hackers stole their credit card and CVV numbers
item.description: Hackers breached e-commerce platform Cleverbridge and made off with payment card data stored on it, the company has confirmed. Cleverbridge handles purchases, payments and subscriptions for other businesses, and its website lists Red Hat, Sony, SUSE, Veeam, Tenable and Jamf among its clients.
